body:
Please add a minimal runnable example that reproduces the failure, your Rich version, and the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`. This may be related to #3088, which reported test failures with Pygments 2.16.1; please include the failing test names and a short expected/actual excerpt so we can compare the reports.
